evidence_quote: This means he has taken pills for 1/5 of the days.
question_evidence_quote: After four-fifths of the days, he has 12 pills left.
observed_error: The response identifies one-fifth of the prescription period as elapsed.
violated_condition: Four-fifths of the 30 days have elapsed; one-fifth remains.
error_description: The response treats one-fifth of the 30-day prescription period as the time during which pills have already been taken. The question states that four-fifths has elapsed, so the six days calculated from one-fifth are the remaining days covered by the 12 pills.
secondary_errors: In the equation 6x = 12 + x, the response uses the daily dose x as the cumulative number of pills taken, without multiplying by the elapsed number of days.
